crossRefs.note: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,
If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness…
“Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
Samuel spoke to all the house of Israel, saying, “If you are returning to Yahweh with all your heart, then put away the…
He did that which was evil, because he didn’t set his heart to seek Yahweh.
Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set…
and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts…
That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,
Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Yahweh. I have spread out my hands to you.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land.

translations.web: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.
translations.bsb: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,
translations.kjv: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands
translations.asv: If thou set thy heart aright, And stretch out thy hands toward him;
